name: Dame Maud of the Vale

intro.text: I am Dame Maud of the Vale, champion of the Guernsey Show five years running and permanent thorn in the side of the Douzaine. I'll bake you a gâche or flatten you, whichever you've the stomach for.

win: Well. You're a better trainer than my cows are milkmaids. Have a slice.
after: I've seen occupation, rationing and tomato blight. A trainer from the mainland doesn't scare me. But I'll admit, you're good.
